set.approach: The road in is seasonal and not ploughed in winter, so the last stretch is often done on skis or snowshoes to the gate on the Fundy Trail Parkway access road. Past the gate, walk to the McCumber Brook lot and follow the signs toward the Walton Glen lookout; a side trail just before the lookout drops to the brook and reaches the climbs on both banks. For the Deliverance area, walk southeast until the Walton Glen drainage is on your right, follow it down to where the brook swings sharply east, then pick up the flagged climbers' path down to the water. Follow the shore to the first climb, which is hard to miss. The route is just right of Paid Vacation, upstream of Walton Glen Falls.
set.descent_text: Rappel the route from the top anchor.

set.approach: The road in is seasonal and not ploughed in winter, so the last stretch is often done on skis or snowshoes to the gate on the Fundy Trail Parkway access road. Past the gate, walk to the McCumber Brook lot and follow the signs toward the Walton Glen lookout; a side trail just before the lookout drops to the brook and reaches the climbs on both banks. From the climbers' path downstream of Walton Glen Falls, cross the brook where it bends right to reach the flat, much-used campsite on the north side; the climbs are reached from there. The routes here face mostly south. From the base of Chock it Up, drop to the foot of a buttress and traverse along the bottom of the cliffs, passing two gullies and a tall rock wall. Enter the large gully beyond, then climb past the free-standing buttress, keeping it on one side, to reach the narrow chimney.
